ns2:section.sectionText: Senior priority enrollment begins November 4th. Junior priority enrollment begins November 11th. Sophomores priority enrollment begins November 16th. For Spring 2016: experiments include VIRTUAL REALITY (3D skiing & motion perception), PRISM ADAPTION (see the world upside-down with inversion goggles), VISUAL ILLUSIONS (slope illusion), and ATTENTION (visual search). For more information and prerequisites see http://publish.illinois.edu/franceswang/psych334/ or contact instructor (Frances Wang, francesw@cyrus.psych.illinois.edu
